title: Kissinger letter to Nixon on prisoners; POWs abandoned in Laos and Cambodia

tellings.quote: I saw a letter from Kissinger to President Nixon saying I'm not going back over there to negotiate for any more prisoners

plain: A former Army intelligence officer and psychic spy named Joe McMoneagle says he once saw a letter from Henry Kissinger, then a top adviser to President Richard Nixon, telling Nixon he would not go back to negotiate for any more prisoners of war. McMoneagle tells it first-hand as evidence that American prisoners were left behind in Laos and Cambodia during the Vietnam War era, around 1970 to 1973.
